name: WooCommerce catalog audit
description: Shop health: system status, product inventory and gaps, review queue, coupon usage sanity, out-of-stock list and order pipeline counts.

steps.title: System status
steps.detail: Call wc_get_system_status and report anything failing (missing requirements, old schema).

steps.title: Catalog inventory
steps.detail: Call wc_list_products (per_page=100) and wc_list_product_categories: report counts by status, products missing price, products missing images.

steps.title: Out of stock
steps.detail: Call wc_list_out_of_stock and propose restock or hide, one product at a time (wc_update_product only with confirmation).

steps.title: Reviews
steps.detail: Call wc_list_reviews (status=hold) and wc_get_product_review_summary for the top products: moderate with wc_approve_review or the reject equivalent on confirmation.

steps.title: Coupons
steps.detail: Call wc_list_coupons and wc_coupon_usage_report: flag expired-but-active and about-to-expire coupons (wc_expire_coupon on confirmation).

steps.title: Order pipeline
steps.detail: Call wc_count_orders_by_status and wc_average_order_value: report the funnel and any order stuck in on-hold longer than the owner's threshold.

steps.title: Report
steps.detail: Deliver the shop health summary with ids and the agreed next actions.

guardrails: Requires WooCommerce active: the install validator checks it via the live tool registry.
Product/status mutations are per-id and owner-confirmed; never bulk-write in an audit.
